steps.en: Add the maven dependency to your app and point it at the admin
steps.zh: 应用里加 maven 依赖，配调度中心地址

steps.en: Write a plain method and annotate it
steps.zh: 写一个普通方法，贴上注解

steps.en: On app startup the embedded executor registers itself with the admin
steps.zh: 应用启动时，执行器自动向调度中心注册

steps.en: Create a job in the web console: cron + handler name
steps.zh: 在网页上建任务，填 cron 和 handler 名

steps.en: When due, picks one executor and triggers it over HTTP
steps.zh: 到点挑一台执行器，通过 HTTP 触发

steps.en: Invokes your method, collects logs and result, retries on failure
steps.zh: 调用你的方法，收回日志与结果，失败自动重试

value.en: Your code only says what the job does; scheduling, dispatch, retries and logs come for free
value.zh: 业务代码里只剩「任务本身干什么」；定时、分派、重试、日志都不用自己写

sources: https://github.com/xuxueli/xxl-job README (features: 调度中心/执行器, Cron 触发, 失败重试; docker xuxueli/xxl-job-admin; maven com.xuxueli:xxl-job-core)
